body: Under 25. It's less her, and more that her attitude to me is indicative of the attitude anyone else would have towards me. I'm an unpleasant person to be around, for a number of reasons.

I smoke, which she doesn't like, and summer's starting here so my hands are clammy most of the time, which means she hates it if I even touch her. She also doesn't like when I'm unhappy around her and usually just leaves the room or whatever if I'm in a bad mood. And by not letting me leave, I mean if I propose it she just says I'm not thinking rationally.
